cohort: 50 patients who underwent emergency peripartum hysterectomy at the Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology, PMCH, Patna, Bihar, India over a 1 year period.
finding: The incidence of emergency peripartum hysterectomy was 0.12%, with the most common indications being atonic postpartum hemorrhage (48%) and uterine rupture (48%).
followup_time: Variable, up to >10 days post-operatively (length of hospital stay)
